selection: Same saved daily entry/cohort rules, budgets and six exits per day. Require positive training returns at 5%/10% sale costs and the named training drawdown ceiling; maximize the 10%-cost return. The robust selector also requires positive training return after removing two best training tokens. Cash is allowed.
state: Controls see only realized cash, prior closed-equity high and completed entered-trade results. Loss streaks, recovery factors, daily peaks and pauses reset on the next UTC entry day; overall closed-equity high carries across days. A pause or rejection leaves later calls on an untraded token eligible. Original one-position, fee-reserve and volume limits remain in force.
scope: Retrospective daily selections on repeatedly examined dates. Training drawdown constraints are not live loss guarantees. Controls do not change frozen validation protocols.
